featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an awful experience with them. For drafting a simple eviction notice they took more than 2 weeks and even then the notice wasn't delivered to the tenant. The money I paid got wasted.

Further, even after the notice came back to their address, they did not inform me. Infact, they called me to file a lawsuit and initially I agreed. Fortunately, they again took time for drafting. Meanwhile I checked with the tenant and subsequently with the Post Office, that is when I came to know the notice had gone back to the lawyers as there was some mistake in the address. They still had the audacity to call me asking for advance payment for the lawsuit. That is when I confronted them asking about the notice not being delivered. They told me the notice returned to them the same day in the morning which was again a lie as the lawyer had no plans of telling me the truth until I confronted them. After that, they never called me back and did not even return my money.

I would never recommend the firm. They are very polite and welcoming but they are very unprofessional and dishonest as well. They just want the money without getting your work done.
